summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing the date for its second quarter 2026 financial results release and conference call. The results will be published on August 7, 2026, before market open, with a call hosted by CEO Rod West and CFO Rob Stefani. This is a routine earnings calendar notification, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, stake changes, or strategic actions are mentioned. The filing is purely administrative and informational, providing standard communication to shareholders and investors regarding upcoming financial disclosures. No special situation applies.
